item.title: Programmers need to start meditating
item.description:
📝 After working full-time like this for ~8 months, one thing I’m sure of is that this way of working involves much less time spent in a flow state. Find another way to settle your mind Until recently, programmers had a meditative job. Now that this has changed, every programmer should probably pick up a new meditative hobby or spend some time deliberately meditating with an app like Calm or Waking Up.
🔗 Read more: https://jacob.gold/posts/programmers-need-to-start-meditating-now/
